description_target.target_text: classify border fragments by oriented bbox edges and repack them into the smallest square

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Scattered frame pieces reassemble into an n-by-n border. Classify
 ;; each piece by which full edges it owns: 1-row strips are TOP runs,
 ;; corner pieces own a full row plus a full column (top-left,
 ;; bottom-left, bottom-right), everything else is a SIDE piece. n =
 ;; the widest assembled edge. Corners and strips chain left-to-right
 ;; along their edge; each side piece climbs up from the bottom corner
 ;; it sat closest to in the input.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg
       (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define (full-row? cells r ww)
       (all? (lambda (c) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 ww)))
     (define (full-col? cells c hh)
       (all? (lambda (r) (member (list r c) cells)) (range 0 hh)))
     (define (classify cells hh ww)
       (cond ((and (= hh 1) (> ww 1)) 'top)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells 0 ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'top-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww) (full-col? cells 0 hh))
              'bottom-left)
             ((and (> hh 1) (> ww 1)
                   (full-row? cells (- hh 1) ww)
                   (full-col? cells (- ww 1) hh))
              'bottom-right)
             (else 'side)))
     ;; entry = (type obj cells hh ww color), cells normalized
     (define entries
       (map (lambda (o)
              (let* ((cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells o)))
                     (hh (+ 1 (max-of first cells)))
                     (ww (+ 1 (max-of second cells))))
                (list (classify cells hh ww) o cells hh ww (obj-color o))))
            (objects g bg)))
     (define (eobj e) (second e))
     (define (ecells e) (third e))
     (define (eh e) (fourth e))
     (define (ew e) (fifth e))
     (define (ecolor e) (sixth e))
     (define (of-type sym)
       (sort (filter (lambda (e) (eq? (first e) sym)) entries)
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 (eobj a)) (obj-c1 (eobj b))))))
     (define (sum-w xs) (apply + (cons 0 (map ew xs))))
     (define top-lefts (of-type 'top-left))
     (define tops (of-type 'top))
     (define bottom-lefts (of-type 'bottom-left))
     (define bottom-rights (of-type 'bottom-right))
     (define sides (of-type 'side))
     (define n
       (max (+ (sum-w top-lefts) (sum-w tops))
            (+ (sum-w bottom-lefts) (sum-w bottom-rights))
            (max-of (lambda (e) (max (eh e) (ew e))) entries)))
     (define (place out e tr tc)
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (p) (list (+ tr (first p))
                                           (+ tc (second p))))
                         (ecells e))
                    (ecolor e)))
     (define (chain-right out xs r c)  ;; pieces side by side along a row
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc c) #:result gg) ((e xs))
         (values (place gg e r cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
     (define (chain-bottom-right out xs)
       (for/fold ((gg out) (cc n) #:result gg) ((e (reverse xs)))
         (define nc (- cc (ew e)))
         (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) nc) nc)))
     (define (center2 e) (+ (obj-c1 (eobj e)) (obj-c2 (eobj e))))
     (define bl-center
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) -9999 (center2 (first bottom-lefts))))
     (define br-center
       (if (null? bottom-rights) 9999 (center2 (first bottom-rights))))
     (define bl-start
       (if (null? bottom-lefts) n (- n (eh (first bottom-lefts)))))
     (define br-start
       (if (null? bottom-rights) n (- n (eh (first bottom-rights)))))
     (define (left-side? e)  ;; climb the wall of the nearer bottom corner
       (cond ((= (length (ecells e)) 1) #f)
             ((null? bottom-lefts) #f)
             ((null? bottom-rights) #t)
             (else (<= (abs (- (center2 e) bl-center))
                       (abs (- (center2 e) br-center))))))
     (let* ((g1 (chain-right (empty-grid n n bg) top-lefts 0 0))
            (g2 (chain-right g1 tops 0 (sum-w top-lefts)))
            (g3 (for/fold ((gg g2) (cc 0) #:result gg) ((e bottom-lefts))
                  (values (place gg e (- n (eh e)) cc) (+ cc (ew e)))))
            (g4 (chain-bottom-right g3 bottom-rights)))
       (for/fold ((gg g4)) ((e sides))
         (if (left-side? e)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- bl-start (eh e))) 0)
             (place gg e (max 1 (- br-start (eh e))) (- n (ew e)))))))))
